title.zh: Meta 超级集群上万块英伟达 GPU 闲置待命
title.en: [TheRegister] Tens of thousands of Nvidia GPUs sit idle in Meta's Prometheus supercluster, just waiting for a failure

title.src: [TheRegister] Tens of thousands of Nvidia GPUs sit idle in Meta's Prometheus supercluster, just waiting for a failure

one_liner.zh: Meta 位于俄亥俄州的 Prometheus 超级集群中超过 11% 的 GPU 损坏或闲置待命。
one_liner.en: More than 11% of GPUs in Meta's Prometheus supercluster in Ohio are broken or idle on standby.
one_liner.de: Über 11 % der GPUs in Metas Prometheus-Supercluster in Ohio sind defekt oder stillgelegt im Wartemodus.

why_it_matters.zh: 大规模 GPU 集群故障不可避免，Meta 以冗余 GPU 等措施保障 Muse 系列模型等 AI 训练不中断
why_it_matters.en: Failures are inevitable in large GPU clusters; Meta uses redundant GPUs and other measures to keep training models like the Muse series running.
why_it_matters.de: Ausfälle sind in großen GPU-Clustern unvermeidlich; Meta sichert mit redundanten GPUs u. a. das Training der Muse-Modelle ab.

selected.quote_en: More than 11 percent of the GPUs at Meta's Prometheus supercluster in New Albany, Ohio, are either dead or sitting idle waiting to step in when the next drops out, Zuckercorp revealed this week.

one_liner.de: Das Cloud-Startup Modal will erstmals Nvidia-Vera-Prozessoren einsetzen, um KI-Agenten zu hosten.

why_it_matters.zh: 早期测试显示 Vera 能让 AI 智能体任务处理吞吐量提升一倍

fresh_24h.quote_en: 该公司表示，计划首次采用英伟达全新 Vera 中央处理器来托管智能体（AI agents），也就是能够替人类执行长周期任务的 AI 系统。
